**Summary:** 698 of 700 tests passed. The run had two failures, both in the auth/tokens.test.js file:

1. **refreshToken silently accepts an already-revoked token** (auth/tokens.test.js:400)
2. **sessionCleanup leaves orphaned rows after a rollback** (auth/tokens.test.js:650)

Both failures are in the authentication token handling code. You may want to look at the refresh token logic and the session cleanup behavior during rollbacks.
